note: The GA4 booking event is recording again, from Wednesday 21 October. That is the most important thing on this page and it has changed since last week. sevenrooms_booking_complete was dead across all three USA properties from 16 to 20 October and came back on 21 October at every venue. Market create-path bookings by day were 4 and 1 on Monday 19 and Tuesday 20 October, then 49, 54, 47, 60 and 46 on 21 to 25 October. So this week is a five-day reading, not a seven-day one. Monday and Tuesday are missing. Over those two days SevenRooms recorded 86 website bookings and 298 website covers against 5 GA4 events. Scaling each venue by its own pre-break ratio of GA4 events to SevenRooms website rows, the two lost days would have carried roughly 110 bookings, so the true week is in the region of 370 rather than the 261 printed here. That is an estimate stated for context only: the figures on this page are left exactly as GA4 returned them and nothing has been scaled, substituted or filled in. Every venue is understated and by about the same amount in proportion: Aqua NYC 140 against roughly 200, Hutong NYC 90 against roughly 130, Hutong Miami 31 against roughly 44. Read the covers report for the week's demand. How the recovery was checked. page_view ran normally at all three properties on every day of both weeks, including the dead days, so collection itself never stopped. The USA properties carry no book_now_button_click event at all, so unlike Cantina in Hong Kong that cross-check is not available here and SevenRooms is the only independent daily measure. From 21 October, GA4 create-path bookings run at 1.48 times the SevenRooms website booking count at Aqua NYC against a pre-break norm of 1.59 to 1.70, at 1.00 times against 1.12 to 1.15 at Hutong NYC, and at 0.85 times against 1.22 to 1.29 at Hutong Miami. Aqua NYC and Hutong NYC are therefore recording properly. Hutong Miami is recording but sits furthest below its own norm, a gap of about 13 bookings over five days, which on counts this small is not enough to call partial under-collection either way. It should be rechecked next week. Basis. GA4 bookings are the create path only: the modify, manage and prearrival pages, where the same event fires when a guest amends a booking, are excluded. The amendment share this week was 10.0 per cent of all booking events across the market, 4.8 per cent at Aqua NYC, 15.1 per cent at Hutong NYC and 16.2 per cent at Hutong Miami, against 6.3 per cent in the year-ago week. That is the reverse of last week's reading and it means the create-path rule now costs 2026 more than it costs 2025 in this market. The year-ago week carries a modify route at Aqua NYC (10.2 per cent) and at Hutong Miami (3.8 per cent) but none at Hutong New York, where every 2025 event still fired on the /reservations/hutongnewyork landing route. Last week's note recorded both Hutongs as structurally zero in 2025; that holds for Hutong New York and is now corrected for Hutong Miami. The current, prior and year-ago weeks and the eight-week series are all built on the create path, so every comparison on this page is like for like. They do not tie to the figures published up to and including w2026-10-05. The year to date is also on the create path. USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive, Hutong NYC explicitly so: its plan hinges on website conversion rising from 4.83 to 6.5 per cent and on a large Meta efficiency fix. Hutong Miami's GA4 target is derived, not given: the workbook plans Meta bookings only, so the monthly Meta figure is scaled by 6738/4756 to reach a GA4 equivalent. This week sits wholly inside October, so the weekly target is not pro-rated across two months: it is each venue's October GA4 target × 7/30, giving Aqua NYC 559 (2,394 monthly), Hutong NYC 490 (2,100) and Hutong Miami 124 (530, derived), 1,173 for the market, the same basis and the same figure as last week. The USA year-to-date target is not reproducible from the workbook by any day-count rule tested, so it is extended from last week's published cumulative by this week's target, as in prior weeks. Google booking conversions and modelled store visits settle upward for two to three weeks and have done so again.
